ai.heading: AI providers
ai.sub: Connect to AI model provider APIs. Each feature, such as bots or scripts, can use a separate provider below.
ai.keyNote: API keys are encrypted when stored on the server and only the last 4 characters are shown. Do not share keys with members.
ai.allocationSub: Only enabled providers can be selected. If the primary provider fails, the system automatically switches to the fallback provider.
ai.botSub: Reply to individual messages in community groups
ai.scriptSub: Generate batches of scripts without duplicates
ai.contentSub: Suggest descriptions for stores, projects and emails
ai.modSub: Classify violating messages before hiding them
ai.fallbackSub: Used when the primary provider fails or reaches its quota
ai.exhausted: Budget exhausted: automatic bots are paused; other features switch to the fallback provider.
ai.logSub: Record purpose, model, token usage and cost; retain for 90 days
ai.piiSub: Mask phone numbers, emails and account numbers in content sent to AI
ai.budgetAlert: Show an Admin warning at the threshold or when the budget runs out; no email is sent.

app.heading: Mobile app & Push notifications
app.sub: OPC Hub works as a phone app (PWA): add it to the home screen and receive push notifications without downloading it from an app store.
app.pwa: Allow installing the OPC Hub app
app.on: Enabled · members can add OPC Hub to their home screen
app.msgSub: When someone mentions or replies to you
app.needSub: Suggestions for new needs in the same industry / province
app.eventSub: 1 day and 1 hour before the event

device.heading: This device
